schemaStability: Stable field names and meanings. `bill` and `billUrl` are null on procedural roll calls that are attached to no measure; `chamber` is published because it cannot be re-derived from the motion text.
title: Georgia General Assembly — Roll-call Votes
description: Passage votes from the Georgia General Assembly, sourced from its own web service at legis.ga.gov. Keyed by vote id in the form "<rollCallId>-<legislationId>" — one floor vote on a bundled calendar appears once per bill, with identical tallies. memberVotes is keyed by the `id` in members data -- an opaque handle (some are OCD-shaped, others 'legis-<legisGaGovId>'; never interpret it). See members.schema.json; legisGaGovId is the primary identity.

metadata.description: Provenance for this file. `session` (e.g. '2025_26', '2026_ss') is the one session these roll calls belong to; `biennium` is the General Assembly that contains it.

chamber.description: The chamber that held this roll call, as recorded by the source. Do NOT infer this from motionText: an 'Agree to Senate Substitute' is a House vote. Absent on records predating this field.

rollNumber.description: The chamber's own roll-call number for the session, counting ALL roll calls (procedural ones included), so it is dense in the source but gapped here. Orders roll calls authoritatively; absent on records predating the field.

time.description: Clock time the roll call was taken, e.g. "2:39 PM".
